rationale: Professional developers using AI coding assistants daily report losing comprehension of their own codebases — a recurring, well-documented pain with multiple corroborating HN threads, Reddit discussions, and industry commentary. Willingness-to-pay is evidenced by existing spend on code-review tooling (CodeClimate ~$20+/mo, Graphite ~$18+/mo, GitHub Copilot $19/mo) and explicit community requests for 'what did the AI actually change' audit trails. Target audience is clearly defined and reachable.
